messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: GPU pool 'gpu-prod-1' queue growing rapidly (>1200 pending). autoscaler hitting max nodes. Pager triggered to #incidents at 2823456789 :rotating_light:

maya_oncall: I'm on it. seeing 95% nodes Util and 1.2k pods waiting in inference-queue. pod throttling spiking. Any recent deploys?

ajay_eng: No new model deploys in last 2 hours. Traffic spike from customer sandbox org_42, steady 4x baseline.

lia_sre: Autoscaler logs show "scaleUp forbidden: quotaExceeded" and cloud provider returning 403 on setMaxNodes. Nodepool maxNodes=120, current=120. Kube-scheduler backlog is piling (pod pending due to no GPU node).

maya_oncall: Customer-facing impact? rachel_support?

rachel_support: Support queue has 3 reports of timeouts for large-batch embeddings. Severity: customer-visible latency/timeouts for a handful of high-QPS tenants. Not a full outage but urgent.

terry_infra: We're blocked by org quota at cloud account level — infra team doesn't have authority to bump beyond 120 without an approved cap raise. Can request emergency bump via console, but need approver.

maya_oncall: Paging exec-ops for emergency cap raise. Meanwhile can we free any nodes? Any non-prod pools to preempt?

ajay_eng: We can temporarily evict lower-priority batch pods in batch-pool-2 to shift capacity, but that will impact nightly jobs. Would reduce pending by ~200.

lia_sre: Attempting manual preemption now: kubectl delete pods -l tier=batch -n batch-workloads --grace-period=0 --force

deploy-bot: deploy completed: rollback of model-serving v2.3 aborted (no effect).

maya_oncall: Good. Start evacuation. Terry, please raise emergency quota to cloud support and CC finance on the exception. Tag it "Redwood:prod-gpu-emergency"

terry_infra: Opening support case now. Reference: case#AUTO-987654. Requesting temporary maxNodes=160 for nodepool gpu-prod-1 for 6 hours.

lia_sre: In parallel I'm going to patch the HPA/karpenter bindings to allow nodeSelectorless fallback to a spare nodepool with smaller GPUs to take lower-priority inference. Patch:```
kubectl patch nodepool gpu-prod-1 -p '{"spec":{"maxNodes":160}}' --type=merge
```

ajay_eng: Note: some models require 16GB GPU memory; fallback pool has 12GB, so we'll need to shard those requests to compatible variants or queue them. I'll push a prompt router tweak to send 12GB-compatible workloads to fallback pool.

maya_oncall: Action list: 1) terry raise cloud quota (in progress). 2) lia preempt batch pods (done ~200 freed). 3) ajay adjust routing rules (in progress). 4) rachel notify affected customers with ETA ~30-45m. 5) maya coordinate rollback if cap not approved.

terry_infra: Support case submitted, ETA from cloud support is 22 minutes. Provided justification + cost owner. (reacts :thumbsup:)

rachel_support: Drafting msg to customers: "We're experiencing capacity constraints affecting some large-batch requests; we are scaling emergency capacity and expect service restoration within ~45 minutes. Contact support for urgency." Will post in status page.

lia_sre: Cloud console shows request approved at 2823459520, I can see policy change to maxNodes=160. Applying patch now.```
kubectl get nodepool gpu-prod-1 -o json | jq '.spec.maxNodes'  # currently 160
```

ajay_eng: Router changes deployed (traffic split 75/25 to fallback). Pending queue dropped from 1200 -> 560. Pod scheduling starting to land on new nodes.

maya_oncall: Any errors in node boot?

lia_sre: A few new nodes failed CNI initialization (2/40) due to AMI mismatch. Replaced via cloud autoheal. Overall node count now 148/160.\
terry_infra: Confirmed cloud billing alert disabled for emergency cap. Will revert after 6h window.

rachel_support: Posted status update and notified the three affected customers directly. Received two replies acknowledging, one asked for SLA credit — escalated to account team.

maya_oncall: Monitoring latency and queue. If backlog <200 and latency normal, we'll start de-escalation.

lia_sre: Current metrics: pending pods 110, token latency within SLO for most tenants, spike still for the largest batches.

ajay_eng: I've queued a follow-up to re-validate autoscaler policy: there's a bug where scaleDownDisabled flag prevented scale-up beyond 75% for nodepool-shared; adding regression ticket.

maya_oncall: Post-incident actions: 1) add runbook step for immediate cloud quota emergency workflow with approvers and template. 2) add guardrail to prompt router to prefer fallback earlier. 3) fix autoscaler policy bug. 4) reconcile cost/finance approval path.

lia_sre: Marking incident as "mitigated" at 2823460000 — leaving nodes up until window end. Will create postmortem with timeline and metrics dump.

maya_oncall: Thanks everyone. Leaving oncall handoff note for next shift: monitor nodepool gpu-prod-1, ensure cloud cap reverts to 120 after window unless approval is extended.

rachel_support: Closing customer notifications thread.

incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated) at 2823461000. Link to postmortem: /incidents/2823456789-postmortem (draft)."
